messages:
Renee (sales): Sable POC kickoff. Prospect wants perf validation + hosted vs reserved pricing. Goals: p95 <= 230ms, p99 <= 420ms at steady 22 qps, with two 45s spikes to 88 qps. Mix: 50% short (~32t), 30% mid (~128t), 20% long (~384t). KV cache ON (~50% prefix-hit). Need run plan + infra rec + quick cost delta by Tue EOD. cc @Hector @Omar

Omar (SE): Ack. Proposed run plan: warm 2m @6 qps, ramp 6 -> 22 over 4m, sustain 22 qps 18m (capture p50/p90/p95/p99 by seqlen), 2x 45s spikes to 88 qps spaced 2m apart. Run fp16 baseline then int8 quant. Tag requests with seq_bucket + cache_hit.

Bea (infra): Recommend dedicated test pool: 2 nodes A100-80G equiv. Per-GPU inflight cap ~44, batch size 1 for low tail. Long prompts may hit memory; instrument max_alloc and p95_by_len. I'll provision test pool when we lock schedule.

Omar (SE): Quick reproducible k6 snippet I'll use (sanitized):
```
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({model:'redwood-v1-large', prompt:'...'}), {headers:{Authorization:'Bearer $TOKEN'}})
}
```

Hector (AE): Customer confirmed Tue 18:00 UTC and will upload 1k sample corpus by Fri. Renee, they asked for hosted vs reserved monthly delta and int8 tradeoffs.

Renee (sales): Great. Omar, include cost calc per-1k-tokens hosted, and amortized reserved for 2-node example, plus note: int8 ~30% cheaper but expect +10-18ms p95 on long prompts.

Bea (infra): deploy-bot: provisioned "sable-poc-usw2-01" (2 nodes) for 2h on 2025-06-10T18:00:00Z. Run kernel-canary first.

Omar (SE): Will post runbook + cost sheet in this thread by Mon EOD. Also adding sensitivity: raising cache-hit to 70% drops cost but can change burst behavior.

Renee (sales): Thanks team. :thumbsup:
